login.title: Sign in to your <hl>account</hl>
login.sub: Sign in to your smart site-care panel.
login.subTotp: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app — or one of your recovery codes.

register.title: Create a <hl>free</hl> account
register.sub: Pilot access — no bank card needed.
register.inviteNotice: You're here through a team invitation. Sign up with the invited email address and you'll become a member of the inviting site once your account is created.
register.failed: Account creation failed. Please try again.
register.inviteNotApplied: The invitation could not be applied.
register.continue: Account created — go to the panel
register.inviteAfterLogin: — after signing in, open the “Accept invitation” link in the email.

reset.title: Reset your <hl>password</hl>
reset.sub: Enter your email; if an account with this email exists, a reset link will be sent to it.
reset.unconfiguredBody: Email sending is not currently configured on this service, so a reset link will not be sent for any account. To reset your password, please ask support.
reset.sentBody: If this email exists in our system, a password reset link has been sent to it.
reset.newSub: The reset link is valid for one hour and can be used only once. Enter your new password.
reset.mismatch: The password and its confirmation don't match.
reset.tooShort: The password must be at least 8 characters.
reset.doneBody: Your new password has been saved. You can sign in now.
